    E

    edu.uky.cs.nil.sg - package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg
     
    Expand - Class in edu.uky.cs.nil.sg
    A task that expands all reachable states of a Tandem Tales logical story world from the initial state using breadth-first search and then translates those states into a story graph.
    Expand(LogicalWorld) - Constructor for class edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Expand
    Constructs a Tandem Tales logical world state graph expander task for the given story world with no limit on the depth of expansion.
    Expand(LogicalWorld, int) - Constructor for class edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Expand
    Constructs a Tandem Tales logical world state graph expander task for the given story world with a limit on the depth of the expansion.
    ExpandTool - Class in edu.uky.cs.nil.sg
    A story graph tool that provides an interface to the Expand task.
    ExpandTool() - Constructor for class edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.ExpandTool
    Constructs a Tandem Tales Logical World story graph expansion tool.
